method: Read-only joins over retained bundles; training tokens from parent-ledger intention.recorded symbols joined to turn scenario hashes; test tokens from branch-ledger turn-0 intention records (treatment-batch.json supplies receiver role and candidate sets only). Missing turn-0 intentions are listed per slot/branch; disabled branches are expected-null, never missing. N1.5 correction 2026-10-10: prior text inverted the test sourcing.
limits: Turn records and transcripts carry hashes only; plaintext comes from ledger intention events.
Candidate-type overlap for training turns is proxied by scenario-hash (dis)equality.
primary-0000 is an aborted training-only run; pooled numbers would mix policies, so dyads stay separate.
Within-case branch coincidences partly reflect N1 control defects (shared seeds, same-example ledger construction), not independent message duplication.
interpretation: Alphabet reuse over 3000 turns of a fixed 32-symbol inventory is expected and is not evidence of duplicated examples. Test-branch coincidences are dominated by construction defects (see the treatment-validity correction), not by independent message duplication. No fitted ordinary baseline exists, so repetition effects under a fitted baseline are unmeasured.
selectedOption: D2 (ratified): keep uniform-null ordinary, no repetition-sensitive modeling; duplication is reported as this census. No fitted ordinary exists to poison; whether repetition would matter under a fitted baseline is unmeasured and stays an open future question.
